user.description:
Enter your Payback customer card number or email address and password.

**💡 How to obtain Session Cookie (F12 Guide):**
1. Open Chrome/Firefox and go to [payback.de/coupons](https://www.payback.de/coupons) & log in.
2. Press **F12** -> **Network tab** (`Netzwerk`).
3. Press **F5** (Refresh) -> Click any request -> Copy the `Cookie:` header (containing `incap_ses...`).
4. Paste it below.

data.session_cookie: Session Cookie (F12 Copy, z. B. incap_ses_...)
